title: Choose a bounded research architecture
gold:
A defensible initial choice is one lead, a durable evidence ledger, and a separate
citation pass, with conditional bounded workers for independent questions.
Alternatives are acceptable if cost uncertainty and permissions remain explicit.
USD 50 cannot establish a run count without current prices and workload volume.

rubric.pass_if: Compares architectures against workload and cap without invented dollar estimates.
Attributes Anthropic results to its own system and does not claim universal superiority.
Reserves citation review and keeps private reads separate from external writes.
Proposes a matched-budget trial and observable reversal condition.

anti_patterns: Recommends many workers solely because a vendor reports gains.
Invents prices or a supported monthly run count.
Treats read access as permission to export private data.
source: work/research/03-research-agent.md, R1; Anthropic multi-agent article and LangChain repository.
